# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon contracts sharply (width < 0.4% of price) indicating low volatility, a shallow pullback to VWAP with a bullish candle offers a mean‑reversion edge. The setup captures short‑term reversion to the intraday fair value after a volatility squeeze, distinct from trending VWAP breaks.

## Mechanism

Calculate ribbon width as (EMA50 - EMA8) / close. If width < 0.004 and price pulls back to within 0.1% of VWAP and the current 5‑minute candle closes above its open (bullish) and above VWAP, enter long at the candle close. Exit: chart‑stop at the recent swing low (prior low before entry) or 0.5% trailing stop, TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off HWM. Avoid during high‑VIX (>20) or when ribbon width is expanding.
